title: SAC telegram on Echo Flight demands Boeing investigation
place_text: Strategic Air Command headquarters / Malmstrom AFB

tellings.quote: There were uh one of the documents we received from the air force was a telegram or TX about the echoflight shutdown.

plain: After a group of nuclear missiles called Echo Flight shut down at Malmstrom Air Force Base in 1967, Strategic Air Command, the Air Force command in charge of nuclear missiles and bombers, is said to have sent a telegram demanding that the company Boeing investigate. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, says this telegram was "one of the documents we received from the air force" about the shutdown. To him it shows the military took the event seriously at the highest level.
